content: Xoossi gizayssa siyite; «Dendite! Intte meto zumatas yootite; zumatikka intte gizayssa siyetto.
Zumatoo! Xoossa mooto siyite; Intteno biitta mino xaphotoo siyite; Xoossas asara palamay dees; izi Isra7eele naytara pirdeettes.
Ta derezoo! Ta nena wosttadinaa? Ta nees aazan tooho gidadinaa? Ane taas zaaro imma.
Ta nena Gibxeppe kessadis; aylleteththa biittafekka wozzadis; nena kaaleththana mala Muse, Aaroonenne Maaramo nees yeddadis.

Ta derezoo! Mo7aabe kawoy Balaaqey iza zoriin Bi7oore naa Balaamey izas zaaroyssa ane yuushshi qopite; Xoossa xilloteththa ooso intte shaakki erana mala, Shiiximeppe Gelgela gakkanaas intte hemettoyssa ane qopite» gides.
Ta ay ekkada Xoossa sinththe shiiqoo? De7o Xoossas wostta goynnoo? Xuugettiza yarsho issi layththa marara gaththa ekka baada iza sinth shiiqooshaa?
Issi shii dharshotanne 10,000 goggiza zaytey Xoossa ufayssandeeshaa? Ta iza qohoyssa gishshas ta bayra naaza immizaakko ta shemppo nagara gishshas ta uloppe wodhdhida yelo izas immooshaa?
Asa nawu! Izi nena lo7o miish bessides Xoossi neeppe koyzay aazee? Lo7o ooththana mala maaroteth ne dosana malanne Xoossa sinththan neni ashketeththara baana mala gidennee?
Xoossas baboy aadhdhida erateththa; Siyite! Xoossi katamayo hizgi xeygees, «Iza hanqo guufeza qopite; hessaka giigsiday oonakko wozinan woththite.»
Iitateththa keeththatoo! Intte genen shiishshida intte miish wordo maka miishshan makki intte shiishshida shuunniza miishshaa ta doganee?
baleththiza maka miish oykkidaade, wordo maka miishsha karaxiiten xunttidaade xillisanaas taas bessizee?
Izi deren dure asati as qohizaadentta; izin diza asay wordanchcha xalla; istta inxarsay baleththiza inxarsa.
Hessa gishshas ta nena dhayssana dendadis; ne nagara geedon ta nena laallana.
Ne maanashin kallaka; ne qanththay coo mela daana; Ne shiishshanashin aykkoka nees shiiqenna; Ne shiishshidayssa tani mashshasinne tooras aaththa immana.
Ne zerana shin maxakka; wogara miththa zayte ne gum7ana shin he zayteza tiyetta; woyne miththa ayfe xunqqa shiishshanashin woyne ushshu ne uyakka.

Kawo Omire wogaanne kawo Akaabe keeththa wogaa ne ubbaa shiishsha oykkadasa; nekka istta haysi7e kaalladasa. Hessa gishshas nena dhayssas, ne derezakka tani qidhes aaththa immana; derey ne bolla qidhi kaa7ana.
